name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
document_title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students — FAQs 2025-26
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for eligible college and university students.
benefit: Financial assistance for higher-education study expenses, subject to the official scheme rules.
manual_review_reason: The current 2026-27 portal status is verified separately; this eligibility record is based on the latest official FAQ document found in the Ministry archive and must be rechecked against the current scheme specification before a final eligibility decision.

clauses.text: Fresh applicants must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant Class XII stream and board.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.reference: FAQ Q1 — eligibility conditions for FRESH application

clauses.text: The student must be pursuing a regular course rather than correspondence or distance mode study.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.reference: FAQ Q1 — eligibility conditions for FRESH application

clauses.text: Annual family income must be no more than INR 4.5 lakh.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.reference: FAQ Q1 — eligibility conditions for FRESH application

clauses.text: The student must not be receiving another scholarship or fee reimbursement.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.reference: FAQ Q1 — eligibility conditions for FRESH application

clauses.text: Diploma students are not eligible under the fresh-application criteria.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.reference: FAQ Q1 — eligibility conditions for FRESH application

clauses.text: Students who took a drop after Class XII are not eligible under the fresh-application criteria.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.reference: FAQ Q1 — eligibility conditions for FRESH application

name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi
authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
description: Central Sector education-loan support for meritorious students admitted to eligible quality higher educational institutions.
benefit: Collateral-free and guarantor-free education loans; interest-subvention benefits apply subject to scheme criteria.
manual_review_reason: Institution-level QHEI status and other current scheme conditions must be checked against the live official portal before a final decision.

clauses.text: The scheme targets students admitted to eligible Quality Higher Educational Institutions identified under the scheme criteria.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

clauses.text: Students with annual family income up to INR 8 lakh can receive the 3% interest-subvention benefit, subject to the scheme conditions.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.reference: FAQ — Features of PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme, item 3

clauses.text: Working professionals pursuing part-time programmes are not covered by the collateral-free and guarantor-free loan benefit under the 2026 clarification.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.document_title: Public Notice — Clarifications regarding eligibility of working professionals pursuing part-time programmes under PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme

clauses.text: The 3% interest-subvention benefit for the income band up to INR 8 lakh is for students not eligible for another government scholarship or interest-subvention benefit.

provenance.authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
provenance.document_title: Ministry of Education Annual Report — PM Vidyalaxmi
provenance.reference: Department of Higher Education — Scholarships — PM Vidyalaxmi, point 4
